version.author: Yeji Jung
version.changelog: First release. Asks the repository whether a newer yj_SoundPicker or yj_SoundSampler has been published, and tells you either way. Press Check for Updates in yj_SoundPicker's settings, or run it from the action list. It runs nothing on its own.

metadata.description:
Tells you whether a newer yj_SoundPicker or yj_SoundSampler is out.
Press Check for Updates in yj_SoundPicker's settings, or run this from the action list. It reports either way, and offers to open ReaPack's synchronize when something is behind.
It runs nothing on its own and nothing in the background, and it never holds REAPER up while it waits on the network.

version.author: Yeji Jung
version.changelog:
First release.
Slots Eight slots, each a ReaSamplomatic5000 on one armed track Whatever you pick in yj_SoundPicker drops into the slot you are working on, including the range you selected on the waveform Key range, root note, in and out points, gain, pan and loop per slot Slots survive closing and reopening: the plugins are found again by ID
Shaping Envelope with a graph you drag by its corners, and an axis that follows whatever length the envelope actually is Three LFOs per slot, one each for volume, pan and pitch, with their own shape, speed and depth
Playing An on-screen piano you can click, and a MIDI keyboard plays the same slots Ctrl+click resets any control, or clears a slot
Fitting in Follows yj_SoundPicker's theme, font size and hover guides

metadata.description:
Plays sounds picked in yj_SoundPicker from a MIDI keyboard.
Eight slots, each one a ReaSamplomatic5000 on a single armed track, with its own key range, root note, in and out points, gain, pan, attack, decay, sustain, release and loop. Tile the slots across the keyboard to split a library of takes, then play and record them in REAPER.
Requires ReaImGui. Works on its own, and follows whatever you pick in yj_SoundPicker.

version.author: Yeji Jung
version.changelog:
Sampler A keyboard button in the top bar opens yj_SoundSampler, which plays the sounds you pick here from a MIDI keyboard. Whatever you select, and the range you select on the waveform, goes straight into the slot you are working on
Waveform Spectral colours: a file whose peak file holds no spectral data now has it built, instead of reporting the colour as unavailable. REAPER writes it while Spectral peaks is on in View > Peaks display settings
Effects Keep FX reads Keep FX between files, and sits beside the monitor level
Updates A Check for Updates button in the settings window, which asks the repository whether a newer yj_SoundPicker or yj_SoundSampler is out and tells you either way. Needs yj_UpdateChecker installed alongside

version.author: Yeji Jung
version.changelog:
Filters Fixed the OR, NOT and exact phrase boxes being quietly emptied when you edited the search box, which made a filter look like it was doing nothing
Effects A reset button on the EQ panel and on the comp panel, so you can start a band over without dragging every node back Keep FX sits on the controls row instead of inside the settings window
Layout The EQ and comp panels work out the width they need, so they wait for a slightly wider window instead of letting a knob run off the edge

version.author: Yeji Jung
version.changelog:
Waveform Reads peaks at screen resolution, so a wide window shows the detail it can hold The centre line runs through silence again Fixed a bar merging across silence and trailing a hairline to the end of the lane
List Drag a header to reorder columns, right-click one to hide it Hidden columns are remembered between sessions
Layout Hide the waveform and the EQ and comp panels for a list-only layout Option to put the waveform above the list Option to keep EQ and comp settings when moving between files
Drag and drop Right-click or Escape cancels a drag in progress Hardened against crashes: ghost items are revalidated every frame, and a selection is clamped to the real file length before anything is placed
Look Simple Dark is now the default Simple's spectral colours show frequency instead of a near-flat grey Rainbow Dark sits on neutral grey so the spectral colours carry Three icon sets: Pixel, Outline and Bulky, now all the same size Fixed no hover highlight in the column menu on Rose and Sage
Setup ReaImGui and SWS are each pointed at the right place when missing A clear message when ReaImGui is older than 0.9, instead of a Lua error

metadata.description:
Reads your existing Media Explorer databases (MediaDB/*.ReaperFileList).
Search: words (AND), OR / comma, NOT / -word, "exact phrase", field:word Tokens: 48k 48k+ 44k- 1ch 2ch+ 24b 16b- 2s 0.5s- 10s+ 3s=
Preview with waveform, range selection, pitch, fit-to-length, EQ and compressor, then spot or drag to the selected track at the edit cursor.
Requires ReaImGui (ReaPack) and the SWS extension (sws-extension.org).
